optimizedDescription.value: YAML schema format: artifacts, workflow, validations, plugins, extends, metadataExtraction, DAG.

optimizedContext.value:
# Schema Format
## Rules
### File structure
- Top-level: `kind` (schema|schema-plugin), `name`, `version`, optional `description`/`extends`, `artifacts` (required for schema), optional `crossArtifactValidations`/`workflow`.
### Kind / extends
- `schema`: full. `schema-plugin`: merge ops only — no artifacts/workflow/metadataExtraction/extends.
- Omit kind → SchemaValidationError. Extends chains root→leaf merge; cycles → SchemaValidationError (by resolved path).
### Array entry identity
- `id` on hooks, validations, deltaValidations, rules.pre/post, preHashCleanup, crossArtifactValidations, metadataExtraction array entries. Format `^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(-[a-z0-9]+)*$`, 1–64.
- Hooks globally unique across ALL workflow steps. Others unique within immediate array. Workflow identity = `step`; participant local id = `as`.
### Artifact definition (key fields)
- Required: `id`, `scope` (spec|change), `output`. Optional: `optional` (default false), `hasTasks`, `template`, `instruction`, `requires`, `format`, `delta` (spec-only), `deltaInstruction`, `deltaValidations`, `validations`, `metadataExtraction`, `rules.pre/post`, `preHashCleanup`, `taskCompletionCheck`.
- `delta:true` + `scope:change` → SchemaValidationError. Filename from last literal glob segment or template.
### artifactDag()
- Canonical API from `requires` only: `roots`, `childrenOf`, `topologicalOrder`, `descendantsOf`. Cached per Schema. Consumers MUST use `schema.artifactDag()` — no parallel rebuilds. `artifactDagFromChangeArtifacts` tests-only when schema available.
### Validations / deltaValidations
- Selector fields (core:selector-model) XOR `path` (JSONPath). Plus `required` (zero-match only), `count` (exactly/min/max/unique.by), `contentMatches`, `children`. deltaValidations same vs delta YAML AST; only when `delta:true`.
### Cross-artifact validations
- `id`, `scope`, `participants` (artifact/as/selector/keySelector?/key), `relation` (`kind`: all-equal|subset|superset, `between`, optional `ordering` ignore|strict). Same-scope artifacts only. Keys not raw AST.
### Metadata extraction
- Top-level field → MetadataExtractorEntry: artifact + extractor (selector, extract, capture, strip, groupBy, transform, fields). Transform via runtime registry. dependsOn: label value + href args. Fail normalize explicitly.
### Workflow / external hooks
- `step`, optional `requires`, `requiresTaskCompletion` (MUST hasTasks:true), `hooks.pre/post`. External hooks: `id` + `external.type` + `external.config`; unknown type rejected.
### Schema resolution
- `@scope/name` npm; `#workspace:name`; `#name`/bare → default workspace; path direct. Missing file → null (caller → SchemaNotFoundError). Zod validate; unknown top-level ignored.
### verify.md
- WHEN/THEN under `### Requirement:` mirroring spec. Schema verify should `requires: [spec]`.
### Plugins
- Inline ops: create/remove/set/append/prepend. Same ref conventions as schemas.
## Constraints
- kind required. Plugin cannot declare artifacts/workflow/metadataExtraction/extends.
- artifact.id `/^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$/`; scope required no default; optional default false.
- Non-optional depends on optional forbidden; requires acyclic.
- deltaValidations only with delta:true. Workflow order = display only (not sequential block).
- Delta format/selectors/apply → core:delta-format.
